name: Fujiwara no Yasuhira
source:
Leader of the Oushuu Fujiwara family.
Kurogane's master and friend of Kurou Yoshitsune.
A discerning and clever man.
His relationship with the protagonist is courteous, but there are times when he seems to cruelly push her away.

- Has a downloadable scenario route in Harukanaru 3 ultimate.
